labels.shortDescription: Stewardship: the plan asked for is missing or switched off
labels.value: That plan is not available. It may have been deleted, or turned off on the Stewardship Plans page.

labels.shortDescription: Stewardship: a plan needs exactly one donor
labels.value: Choose one person or one organization to run this plan for, not both and not neither.

labels.shortDescription: Stewardship: the person starting a plan cannot see the donor
labels.value: You cannot see this donor, so no plan was started.

labels.shortDescription: Stewardship: this plan is already running for this donor
labels.value: This plan is already running for this donor. Mark the running one complete or cancelled before starting it again, so the same tasks are not created twice.

labels.shortDescription: Stewardship: the plans and their templates did not line up
labels.value: BarnCRM could not start one or more stewardship plans because the plans and their templates did not line up. No tasks were created. This is a fault in BarnCRM, not something to correct in your data.

labels.shortDescription: Stewardship: the page title
Stewardship: editing a plan does not reach into running plans
labels.value: Editing a plan changes what starts next. Plans already running keep the tasks they laid out, because those tasks are already in people's lists and weekly plans.

labels.shortDescription: Stewardship: this user may read but not change plans
labels.value: You can read the plans here. Changing them needs the Manage BarnCRM Settings permission.

labels.value: That did not work. The details are in the Error Log. Try again, and if it keeps happening, ask your BarnCRM admin to check it.

Start plan action: placeholder of the plan picker
Start plan action: the button that starts the plan
Start plan action: no plan is turned on
labels.value: No stewardship plan is turned on. An administrator writes plans and turns them on in BarnCRM Settings, Giving, Stewardship plans.

labels.shortDescription: Start plan action: toast after a plan starts
labels.value: The plan has started. Its tasks are in the task lists of the people they are assigned to.

labels.shortDescription: Start plan action: the person may not start a plan
labels.value: You can see stewardship plans but not start one. Ask your BarnCRM admin for the Fundraising Staff role, together with the Giving Staff permission set.
